versions.subject: rule: suspicious PowerShell encoded command patterns
versions.detection:
encoded:
  Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
  CommandLine|contains: 
      - ' -e '
      - ' -en '
      - ' -enc '
      - ' -enco'
selection:
  CommandLine|contains:
      - ' JAB'
      - ' SUVYI'
      - ' SQBFAFgA'
      - ' aWV4I'
      - ' IAB'
      - ' PAA'
      - ' aQBlAHgA'
condition: encoded and selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\powershell.exe" CommandLine IN ("* -e *", "* -en *", "* -enc *", "* -enco*") CommandLine IN ("* JAB*", "* SUVYI*", "* SQBFAFgA*", "* aWV4I*", "* IAB*", "* PAA*", "* aQBlAHgA*")
